messages:
maria-marketing: Hey team — need a concise 1-pager for sales to hand to enterprise prospects. Focus: security & compliance, SLA guarantees, and deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private). Also include quick inbound lead routing guidance and suggested webinar hooks. Goal: one page, 3 bullets per section, and an appendix line for benchmark summary. Deadline EOD Thurs.

aj-growth: +1 — can we include a short comparison table vs. major cloud managed endpoints? Sales want quick talking points not a full benchmark.

devon-sales: For field: 1) emphasize VPC/private control 2) SLA numbers and refunds 3) migration path from hosted -> dedicated. Also include suggested objection responses: "What about data residency?" "We can deploy to govcloud/region X + KMS" :thumbsup:

nisha-product: I'll draft the technical bullets. Suggested SLA language: "99.95% uptime for Dedicated with 15min incident response; hosted tier: 99.9% availability." Need ops to confirm numbers. For deployment modes: include diagrams? maybe 1-line each.

chad-legal: Don't put refundable SLA amounts in a marketing one-pager unless Legal signs off. Suggest we state "SLA-backed uptime options" + link to SLA doc. For security: cite SOC2, ISO27001 if available — confirm.

launch-bot: Reminder: Marketing assets must pass compliance review. Submit final draft by 2024-06-12 17:00 UTC.

aj-growth: For benchmark narrative: give a 1-sentence summary: "Redwood reduces per-token latency by X% vs vanilla endpoints through batching & smart routing" — avoid precise numbers unless we have lab results. Suggest we include a single highlighted stat (e.g., median p95 latency improvement) with link to benchmark doc.

maria-marketing: Good point. We'll add a placeholder stat and a link to the benchmark doc in the appendix. Devon — can you add 2 quick sales quotes that call out migration path & cost predictability?

devon-sales: Sure. Quick ones: "We moved to Redwood Dedicated and cut inference cost variability by 3x while keeping p95 latency under 250ms" and "Private deployment let us meet our auditors' requirements in 4 weeks". I'll keep them short.

nisha-product: Draft outline I'm attaching below (paste):

```
One-pager outline:
- Top header: Value prop (2 lines)
- Security & compliance: bullets (encryption, KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC2)
- SLA & reliability: bullets (tiers + quick fallback story)
- Deployment modes: Hosted / Dedicated / Private (1-liners + best-fit)
- Cost/Performance playbook: batching, caching, quantization callouts
- Sales playbook: inbound routing, gating, trial -> Dedicated trigger
- Appendix: benchmark highlight + link
```

maria-marketing: This is great. Two asks: 1) Can marketing make the visual that maps deployment mode to buyer persona (e.g., growth startup -> Hosted; Platform -> Dedicated; Regulated -> Private) 2) Add a one-line webinar CTA.

aj-growth: For inbound lead routing - suggest: tag leads by "deploy_interest" field (hosted/dedicated/private) and route to AE queue with template messages. Add nurture: invite to on-demand demo + benchmark PDF.

devon-sales: Template message suggestion: "Thanks for your interest — can you share your primary constraint (cost/latency/compliance)? We'll match you to a deployment recipe and a short ROI estimate." Keep as 1-liner.

chad-legal: Also, include a short data residency blurb: "Customer data can remain in customer VPC / on-prem; Redwood does not retain customer content in Dedicated/Private by default" — confirm with infra.

nisha-product: Confirmed: Dedicated and Private modes can be configured to not persist logs and store only minimal telemetry. I'll add that line.

maria-marketing: Okay next steps: Nisha to drop a first draft doc in Google Drive by EOD; Aj will draft the benchmark blurb; Devon will send two quotes; Chad will approve security copy; I'll create the visual and webinar CTA. Will reconvene Thurs 10am PT for review.

aj-growth: Added a sample benchmark blurb in thread: "Lab test (internal) shows 40% reduction in median inference latency for batchy workloads vs unmanaged endpoints; results vary by model and config — see benchmark link." Tag as internal.

devon-sales: +1 on meeting. I'll also prepare the sales routing flow in Notion.

maria-marketing: Thanks everyone. If anyone has objections to placeholder SLA language, raise them before the review meeting.

nisha-product: one last note: for the one-pager header copy try "Predictable, secure LLM inference — wherever you run it." Short and specific.

maria-marketing: Perfect. I'll set calendar invite. :calendar:
